;; Fixture for the active bracket-pair guide.
;;
;; Shapes on purpose: a single-line pair, a multi-line pair whose closer is
;; indented past its opener, nesting three deep, and brackets inside a comment
;; and a string that the scan must not count.
(def single (+ 1 2))

(defn multi [n : int] : int
  (let [doubled (* n 2)]
    (+ doubled
       1)))

;; a stray ( in a comment
(def bracket-text "unclosed ( and ] inside a string")

(def deep (+ 1 (* 2 (- 3 4))))
